summary: Stage the exact Hosting build before deploying backend services and document partial-release recovery.

api.reason: Staging changes deployment ordering only. The candidate and live OpenAPI are checked against the built contract.
api.permissions: No API or customer authorization changes. The temporary Hosting domain is excluded from Firebase Auth domain sync.

metrics.reason: Existing application and workflow metrics measure the same operations. No request or polling change.

traces.reason: Existing request and CI reporting traces are reused. Hosting is promoted via the same Actions job.

logs.reason: Actions logs record the candidate release identity and separate staging and promotion outcomes.

businessEvents.reason: Hosting promotion is infrastructure maintenance without domain writes or settings changes.

deploymentEvents.reason: Deployment reporting requires the staged Hosting gate to succeed in addition to backend, promotion and live checks.

manualVerification: Check the production Actions staging, ingress and promotion steps. Then verify the exact public Hosting commit and OpenAPI on salesdrone.in and confirm the protected API returns 401. No real-account writes or intentional production failures are needed.
